jurisdiction.localityScope: not yet populated with municipality or feeder-level data

sources.publisher: National Transmission Company South Africa / Eskom System Operator
sources.title: Medium-Term System Adequacy Outlook 2027–2036 (Refined Draft)
sources.reportingPeriod: Study horizon 2027–2036; information base stated as September 2026 unless otherwise noted
sources.scope: Hourly chronological network-constrained production-cost adequacy assessment with regional nodes/transmission corridors and 200 Monte Carlo samples per study year
sources.claimCeiling: Refined draft and conditional model outcomes, not a firm forecast, investment recommendation, operational plan, municipal feeder reliability dataset or delivery commitment

sources.title: Transmission Development Plan 2025–2034 Public Report
sources.scope: Public transmission development plan and project/corridor planning context
sources.claimCeiling: Planned projects and kilometres are not commissioned capacity, approved workfronts or available transfer capability

sources.title: Eskom continues to deliver sustained gains as EAF reaches 68.2% and 1.6 million customers exit load reduction
sources.scope: Operator-reported generation fleet availability and load-reduction programme context
sources.claimCeiling: National generation fleet indicator only; not local outage frequency, feeder availability, customer minutes lost, municipal service quality or independently audited measurement

sources.publisher: Department of Electricity and Energy / National Treasury, Government of South Africa
sources.title: Government reaffirms commitment to landmark Independent Transmission Projects
sources.reportingPeriod: Independent Transmission Projects Programme Phase I
sources.scope: Government-announced programme scope of approximately 1,164 km of new transmission infrastructure
sources.claimCeiling: Programme scope is not proof of construction, commissioning, transfer capacity, private financing close or operational readiness

reportedFindings.metric: annual unserved energy exceeds the 20 GWh assessment criterion in Reference Case
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: The report attributes the main shortfall driver to a local transmission constraint at one substation; this is not a distribution feeder/customer outage measure

reportedFindings.metric: fourth 315 MVA transformer assumed to relieve identified local transmission constraint
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: A model assumption, not proof of procurement, installation, commissioning, approval or actual bottleneck relief

reportedFindings.metric: load at risk from a second local substation constraint
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: Modelled load exposure at a substation; not a measured customer interruption or municipality-specific reliability statistic

reportedFindings.metric: annual unserved energy exceeds 900 GWh in Perfect Storm scenario
reportedFindings.scenario: Perfect Storm (65% EAF, no new gas capacity, high demand, lower SSEG)
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: Conditional scenario result, not forecast or probability-weighted expectation; scenario is explicitly not assigned a probability

reportedFindings.metric: conditional value at risk exceeds 2,000 MW in Perfect Storm scenario
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: Tail-severity output of NTCSA's own model; do not transfer as calibrated probability or local asset risk
Eskom-reported national fleet availability; not distribution reliability or customer service restoration

reportedFindings.metric: Phase I Independent Transmission Projects programme infrastructure scope
reportedFindings.interpretationLimit: Announced programme scope, not built or commissioned transmission infrastructure

dataGaps.requiredData: Rights-cleared, versioned municipal or Eskom distribution interruption chronology with coverage and denominator
dataGaps.doNotInfer: Do not derive local feeder SAIDI, SAIFI, outage frequency or customer minutes from national EAF or transmission adequacy model output

dataGaps.requiredData: Customer- or feeder-level energy not supplied/load restoration traces
dataGaps.doNotInfer: Do not assign customer ENS from national annual UE without an approved downscaling/model interface

dataGaps.requiredData: Applicable local asset exposure/fragility data and event provenance
dataGaps.doNotInfer: Do not create flood, fire, heat, wind or seismic probabilities from an enumerated scenario catalogue

dataGaps.requiredData: Municipality/feeder-resolved customer load reduction definitions, population coverage and time series
dataGaps.doNotInfer: Do not equate load reduction with national load-shedding or with a network outage

dataGaps.requiredData: Exact downloaded PDF bytes, SHA-256, extraction version and permitted reuse review for each public source
dataGaps.doNotInfer: These web references are not yet a frozen source corpus; no reproducibility claim may rely on unpinned PDF content
